    return '.'.join([chr(ord('a') + (i % 26))]*127) + '.'

for i in range(900):
    recs.append({'owner':longname(200+i),'type':'TXT','data':'x'*256})
print('recs',len(recs), 'distinct owners', len({r['owner'] for r in recs}))
test=lambda doc,l: print(l, subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True).stdout.decode()[:50].strip())
test({'zones':[{'origin':'.','records':recs}],'profiles':[{'id':'p','max_aliases':1,'cname':'follow','wildcard':'rfc'}],'queries':[],'observations':[]},'all recs')
test({'zones':[{'origin':'.','records':recs[:66]}],'profiles':[{'id':'p','max_aliases':1,'cname':'follow','wildcard':'rfc'}],'queries':[],'observations':[]},'66 cname')
test({'zones':[{'origin':'.','records':recs[66:]}],'profiles':[{'id':'p','max_aliases':1,'cname':'follow','wildcard':'rfc'}],'queries':[],'observations':[]},'900 txt')
